messages.呼吸を貯めてパッシブでクイックを得て、敵との速度差でスキルを強化する貫通アタッカ: A Pierce attacker that builds Poise, gains Haste through his passive, and enhances skills through Speed differences. In Rupture teams, he can attack without reducing the Rupture established by allies.
messages.呼吸→クイック→速度差: バトルパッシブ「決闘生放送」(傲慢×2・暴食×2・保有: **Poise→Haste→Speed difference**: Through the combat passive Duel Livestream (2 Pride and 2 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Haste next turn at Turn End for every 3 Poise Potency, up to 2. He gains Poise from Coin Ⅱ of S2 Fente (2 Poise) and on Clash Win with S3 Salut (5 Poise).
messages.速度差で強化: S1「アレ」は速度差3につきコイン威力+1(最大2)、S2・守備: **Speed-difference bonuses**: S1 Allez gains +1 Coin Power per 3 Speed difference, up to 2, and S2 and the Defense skill Défensive gain Coin Power at a difference of 3 or more. S3 gains +1 Coin Power per 2 Speed difference, up to 3.
messages.破裂の維持: S1〜S3は、対象の破裂が15かつ破裂回数が3以上なら、的中時に破: **Maintaining Rupture**: If the target has 15 Rupture and at least 3 Rupture Count, S1–S3 do not consume Rupture Count on hit (S1 and S2 instead inflict no Rupture). In that case, S2 gains Critical damage equal to the amount it did not inflict.
messages.集中攻撃-ムルソー(おまけ): 基本攻撃スキルが当たると次のターンに付与する。S: **Focused Attack - Meursault (minor)**: Applied next turn when his basic attack skills hit. Coin Ⅲ of S3 deals more damage per Focused Attack, and defeating an enemy with that Coin reuses S3 once. However, it requires attacking the same slot repeatedly, so it is hard to pull off on purpose.
messages.サポートパッシブ「もう1歩素早く」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにい: **Support passive — One Step Ahead (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, the 1 fastest ally gains 1 Haste next turn on Clash Win, twice per turn.
messages.S3はマッチ勝利で呼吸5を得られるので、マッチで勝てる相手に当てる。呼吸を貯めて: S3 grants 5 Poise on Clash Win, so throw it at opponents it can beat. Build Poise, create Speed differences with Haste, and fight with enhanced S1–S3. In Rupture teams, he also serves to maintain the Rupture applied by allies.
